---
title: "Grant Radar"
format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    nav-buttons:
      - icon: github
        href: https://github.com/muntasirmasum/grant-radar
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false
notices = {
  try { return await FileAttachment("notices.json").json(); }
  catch (e) { return []; }
}

today = new Date()
cutoff7  = { const d = new Date(today); d.setDate(d.getDate() - 7);  return d; }
cutoff30 = { const d = new Date(today); d.setDate(d.getDate() - 30); return d; }

// All recently-released notices in the window.
last7  = notices.filter(n => n.release_date && new Date(n.release_date) >= cutoff7)
last30 = notices.filter(n => n.release_date && new Date(n.release_date) >= cutoff30)

upcomingDeadlines = {
  const out = [];
  for (const n of notices) {
    let kds; try { kds = JSON.parse(n.key_dates_json || "[]"); } catch (e) { kds = []; }
    for (const kd of kds) {
      const d = new Date(kd.date);
      if (isNaN(d) || d < today) continue;
      if (kd.type === "release") continue;
      out.push({date: kd.date, label: kd.label, type: kd.type, notice_id: n.notice_id, title: n.title, url: n.url});
    }
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.date, b.date));
}

actionTypes = ["rescission", "change", "reissue", "rfa", "nofo"]
actionCount30 = last30.filter(n => actionTypes.includes(n.notice_type)).length

icsTouched30 = {
  const s = new Set();
  for (const n of last30) for (const ic of (n.issuing_orgs || [])) s.add(ic);
  return s.size;
}

profile = {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem("grant-radar.profile.v1");
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : { ics: [], mechs: [], topics: [], career: "any" };
  } catch (e) { return { ics: [], mechs: [], topics: [], career: "any" }; }
}

function matchScore(n, p) {
  let s = 0;
  for (const ic of (n.issuing_orgs || [])) if (p.ics.includes(ic))    s += 1;
  for (const m  of (n.mechanisms   || [])) if (p.mechs.includes(m))   s += 1;
  for (const t  of (n.topics       || [])) if (p.topics.includes(t))  s += 1;
  if (p.career && p.career !== "any" && (n.career_stages || []).includes(p.career)) s += 0.5;
  return s;
}

profileEmpty = (!profile.ics?.length && !profile.mechs?.length && !profile.topics?.length && (!profile.career || profile.career === "any"))

ranked7 = profileEmpty
  ? last7.map(n => ({...n, _score: 0}))
  : last7.map(n => ({...n, _score: matchScore(n, profile)})).sort((a, b) => d3.descending(a._score, b._score) || d3.descending(a.release_date, b.release_date))

// Top topics and top ICs across the last-30-day window.
topicCounts = {
  const m = new Map();
  for (const n of last30) for (const t of (n.topics || [])) m.set(t, (m.get(t) || 0) + 1);
  return Array.from(m, ([topic, n]) => ({topic, n})).sort((a, b) => d3.descending(a.n, b.n)).slice(0, 8);
}
icCounts = {
  const m = new Map();
  for (const n of last30) for (const ic of (n.issuing_orgs || [])) m.set(ic, (m.get(ic) || 0) + 1);
  return Array.from(m, ([ic, n]) => ({ic, n})).sort((a, b) => d3.descending(a.n, b.n)).slice(0, 8);
}

// Weekly release counts for the last 12 weeks.
weeklyCounts = {
  const buckets = new Map();
  for (const n of notices) {
    if (!n.release_date) continue;
    const d = new Date(n.release_date);
    // Bucket by ISO week-start Monday.
    const mon = new Date(d); mon.setDate(d.getDate() - ((d.getDay() + 6) % 7));
    const key = mon.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    buckets.set(key, (buckets.get(key) || 0) + 1);
  }
  return Array.from(buckets, ([week, n]) => ({week: new Date(week), n})).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.week, b.week)).slice(-12);
}
```

## Row {height=42%}

### Column {width=58%}

::: {.card title="This week, ranked for you"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="font-size:0.85em;color:#64748b;margin-bottom:0.5em;">
  ${profileEmpty
    ? html`No profile saved. <a href="profile.html">Set one</a> to re-rank.`
    : html`Ranked against your <a href="profile.html">profile</a>.`}
</div>`

html`<div style="max-height:340px;overflow-y:auto;">${ranked7.map(n => html`
  <div style="border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:0.5em 0;">
    <div style="font-size:0.8em;color:#64748b;">
      ${n.notice_id} · ${n.notice_type} · ${(n.issuing_orgs || []).slice(0, 2).join(", ")}${(n.issuing_orgs || []).length > 2 ? ", …" : ""}
      ${n._score > 0 ? html`<span style="float:right;background:#10b981;color:white;padding:0 0.4em;border-radius:0.2em;font-size:0.9em;">match ${n._score}</span>` : ""}
    </div>
    <div style="font-weight:600;font-size:0.95em;margin:0.15em 0;">
      <a href="${n.url}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">${n.title}</a>
    </div>
    ${n.purpose_tldr
      ? html`<div style="font-size:0.9em;">${n.purpose_tldr}</div>`
      : html`<div style="font-size:0.85em;font-style:italic;color:#94a3b8;">TL;DR pending /refresh-tldrs</div>`}
    <div style="font-size:0.8em;color:#475569;margin-top:0.15em;">
      ${n.release_date}${(n.topics || []).length ? " · " + n.topics.join(", ") : ""}
    </div>
  </div>`)}</div>`
```

:::

### Column {width=42%}

::: {.card title="Upcoming deadlines"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="max-height:340px;overflow-y:auto;">${
  upcomingDeadlines.length === 0
    ? html`<em style="color:#94a3b8;">No future deadlines extracted yet — calendar fills in as notices arrive.</em>`
    : upcomingDeadlines.slice(0, 30).map(d => html`
        <div style="border-bottom:1px solid #f1f5f9;padding:0.4em 0;font-size:0.9em;">
          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;">
            <span style="font-weight:600;">${d.date}</span>
            <span style="color:#64748b;font-size:0.85em;">${d.type || ""}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="color:#475569;">${d.label}</div>
          <div style="font-size:0.8em;"><a href="${d.url}" target="_blank">${d.notice_id}</a> — ${d.title.slice(0, 80)}${d.title.length > 80 ? "…" : ""}</div>
        </div>`)
}</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 140,
  height: 280,
  y: { label: null },
  x: { label: "notices" },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(topicCounts, { y: "topic", x: "n", fill: "#3b82f6", sort: { y: "x", reverse: true } }),
    Plot.text(topicCounts, { y: "topic", x: "n", text: "n", dx: 5, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#1e293b" }),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  height: 280,
  y: { label: "notices / week" },
  x: { label: null, type: "time" },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(weeklyCounts, { x: "week", y: "n", fill: "#dbeafe", fillOpacity: 0.6, curve: "monotone-x" }),
    Plot.lineY(weeklyCounts, { x: "week", y: "n", stroke: "#3b82f6", strokeWidth: 2, curve: "monotone-x" }),
    Plot.dot(weeklyCounts, { x: "week", y: "n", fill: "#3b82f6" }),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```
